verdict.rationale: Ramp ships a built-in AI assistant layer (Ramp Intelligence/agents) plus an official MCP server (mcp.ramp.com) letting users delegate reads, approvals, and purchases via natural language inside Claude/ChatGPT and other AI tools, corroborated by a live OAuth probe showing granular scopes and a real production endpoint. Documentation details guardrails (human-in-the-loop, audit logging) and concrete delegated tasks (balance checks, approvals, expense coding), going well beyond a vague promise. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on user report of actually delegating a task through the assistant (only vendor docs and a technical probe), so real-world reliability is unverified.
